name: assessments_feedback_to_place
description: List feedback waiting for you to place on a capability: items about you, and items about the people you place feedback for. scope "team" (the default) covers your direct reports and the assessments you hold a rating delegation for; "org" adds everyone deeper in your org. counts gives both sizes, so you can tell when more waits beyond your team. Each item carries its assignment_id; place one with assessments_add_evidence_link, or read its pending suggestions with assessments_evidence_suggestions_list.
